title: Verify node-down alert fired for the vanished pc01 worker (2026-10-12→14)
description: VM 100 (talos-pc01, sole Proxmox guest, no pinned workloads) was off 2 days. node-down.yaml should have paged on kube_node_status_condition Ready!=true. Check Discord history + vmalert state for 2026-10-12→14. If delivery is missing — e.g. the node object vanished from kube-state-metrics instead of going NotReady — extend the expr with an absent()/kube_node_info clause so a missing production worker pages.
notes: EVIDENCE 2026-10-15: Historical - KubeNodeNotReady DID fire for pc01 during 2026-10-12..14 (vmsingle ALERTS query_range: 25 firing samples, severity=critical environment=production) and reached discord via the pre-existing explicit critical route: discord notifications deltas in window are large (280/353/346/318/322/291/231/137/42/68...) with increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total{integration=discord}) = 0 across the entire window. KubeNodeUnreachable never fired - correct, pc01 went NotReady (condition present), not vanished. The vanished-node-object gap tk-lqz anticipated is patched: KubeNodeMetricsAbsent (absent(kube_node_status_condition{condition=Ready}), for 10m, critical) added to node-down.yaml, and its synthetic verification (kube-state-metrics scaled to 0, series vanish, alert must fire+deliver) is running right now as the tk-pqp test.
acceptance_criteria: Either Discord delivery evidence recorded, or expr patched and verified with a synthetic series.
